entities.summary: Nikolai Yakovlevich Ilyin was one of the top Soviet snipers of World War II. Awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union on 8 February 1943 for his first 216 kills, by the time he was killed in action later that year his tally reached 494, thus being considered as one of the deadliest snipers in history.
